subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts a complete glossy red high-heel shoe complete with a small bow on the toe.

category.why: The shoe rests on a plain flat yellow surface against a plain gradient wall in the same warm colour family, seen from slightly above.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The shoe is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm, and saturated palette with the red shoe clearly standing out against the bright yellow backdrop.

detail.why: Clean, smooth surfaces without unnecessary micro-textures, scratches, or extra props.

style.why: Features chunky, smooth volumes and a subtle glossy sheen matching the casual game card art style of the references.
